entries.title: Spirit Hunter: Death Mark
entries.definitive_edition: Nintendo Switch release with Chapter 7 DLC

emulation.emulator: Native Switch hardware; native Windows PC for the less-complete PC route
emulation.notes: Use Switch for the complete DLC route. Use PC only if the DLC tradeoff is acceptable.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Switch completeness route; PC has easier capture but documented DLC loss.

primary.why: The Switch release is the most complete route because the paid Chapter 7 DLC is not available on PC, while Switch has the modern enhanced release path.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Spirit Hunter: Death Mark on Switch and add the Chapter 7 DLC if it is not already bundled in the current storefront region. Use PC only if higher capture convenience matters more than that DLC.

entries.remaster_caveats: Later ports add higher resolution, gallery support, and the new episode route; no full remake was identified.

entries.title: Spirit Hunter: NG

emulation.notes: Use the native Steam release for capture.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC presentation with PC capture/display flexibility.

primary.why: Spirit Hunter: NG released on Vita, PS4, Switch, and Windows with no sourced platform-exclusive content split, making the Steam PC release the best fidelity/capture route.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Spirit Hunter: NG on Steam for the primary route. Use PS4, Switch, or Vita only for platform preference.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remake or remaster distinction was identified; this is the PC release of the second Spirit Hunter game.

entries.title: Spirit Hunter: Death Mark II

emulation.notes: Use the native Steam release for capture.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC presentation with PC capture/display flexibility.

primary.why: The worldwide Steam PC release is the best fidelity/capture route for Death Mark II, while Switch, PS4, and PS5 are alternate console routes with no sourced exclusive content advantage.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Spirit Hunter: Death Mark II on Steam for the primary route. Use PS5, PS4, or Switch only for platform preference.

entries.remaster_caveats: Third Spirit Hunter entry; not a remake/remaster of Death Mark or NG.
